WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.trdref) AS trader_count
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
), stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(trader_count) AS avg_count, SUM(trader_count) AS total_count
  FROM per_type
)
SELECT p.tradekind,
       p.trader_count,
       1.0 * p.trader_count / s.total_count AS share_of_total,
       p.trader_count - s.avg_count AS above_average_by
FROM per_type AS p
CROSS JOIN stats AS s
WHERE p.trader_count > s.avg_count;
